intro: Union Dale is a small borough in southern Susquehanna County, near the Wayne County line, in a part of the dry-gas Marcellus fairway that has seen somewhat less intensive development than the more concentrated drilling areas further north around Montrose and Dimock. That doesn't mean the area lacks value, but it does mean we approach an offer here with a careful look at actual local unit and permit activity rather than assuming county-wide averages apply.
Because Union Dale sits near a county line, confirming exactly which courthouse holds your deed history is one of the first things we check before doing any further research.

paragraphs: If your family's property near Union Dale sits close to the Wayne County line, we verify whether your specific parcel is recorded in Susquehanna or Wayne County before pulling any title history. It's a small step that avoids wasted time searching the wrong courthouse's records.

faqs.question: What if my family's deed hasn't been updated since my grandparents passed away?
